record.oneLiner: Attio is a modern, customizable CRM with a comprehensive REST API and an official hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server available on all tiers including Free.
record.verdictReason: Attio provides self-serve API access and an official MCP server on its free plan without requiring human approval.
